description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'MembershipServiceTest' for the 'MembershipService' in the OrangeHRM system, testing various service methods related to membership management.

classes.name: MembershipServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of MembershipService methods in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a new instance of MembershipService and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of membership list from the service, mocking the DAO response.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific membership by ID, mocking the DAO response.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deletion of memberships by IDs, ensuring the service calls the DAO correctly and returns the expected count.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of membership by name, mocking the DAO response.
